title: How does the stock market work?
excerpt: What actually happens when you buy a share of a public company.
body: A share represents an ownership interest in a company. Public markets allow those shares to be traded between buyers and sellers through exchanges and other trading venues.
Prices move as participants continuously reassess expected profits, risks, interest rates and the price they are willing to pay.
Short-term market moves can be noisy. Over longer periods, business performance, cash flows and valuation become central to investment outcomes.
